In conclusion, we have proposed a conceptually new counter electrode for perovskite-based solar cells. Different from the conventional counter electrodes which are fabricated directly on other component layers of a device, the new type of counter electrode is prepared on a separated substrate and then assembly with other components to complete the device. Spongy carbon film was prepared on FTO glass substrate with a facile and low-cost method and applied as the new type of counter electrode for a prototype device, which exhibited a power conversion efficiency of 4.24%.
